propositions: rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log silently discards history that exists only in prior SNAPSHOT when source events were deleted during pre-16640a705d compaction, causing 214 closed tickets to revert to open/in_progress with 480 total events lost

Rebuild mode replays raw events from index 0 after pre-stripping SNAPSHOTs, assuming retired files are complete; this assumption is violated for tickets compacted before Jul-7 fix when folded events were deleted rather than moved to *.retired

fsck --repair runs whole-ticket rebuilds when triggered by auto-recover orphans, rewriting all state including order-sensitive STATUS events regardless of whether they originated from folded/deleted sources
--repair-snapshots --dry-run mutates the store instead of previewing changes, unlike the batched --repair path which honors dry_run
A store-wide fsck scan reveals 505 latent tickets whose SNAPSHOTs cite missing source events, representing ongoing vulnerability to data loss if rebuild is triggered
